citations.label: Hugging Face: AI evals are becoming the new compute bottleneck
citations.excerpt: The Holistic Agent Leaderboard (HAL) recently spent about $40,000 to run 21,730 agent rollouts across 9 models and 9 benchmarks. A single GAIA run on a frontier model can cost $2,829 before caching. Exgentic's $22,000 sweep across agent configurations found a 33x cost spread on identical tasks.

citations.label: Yehudai et al., A Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents (arXiv 2503.16416)
citations.excerpt: Current evaluations often prioritize performance while overlooking cost and efficiency measurements. Many current benchmarks rely on coarse-grained, end-to-end success metrics that, while useful for gauging overall performance, fall short in diagnosing specific agent failures.
